image_description: A hyper-realistic image of a newborn baby lying on its back on a yellow and white patterned blanket. The baby is wearing a white diaper with visible elastic ruffles at the leg openings. An adult hand is gently holding the baby's legs up, exposing the diaper area. The lighting is soft and diffuse, typical of studio photography.
